snippet.title: Shroud of Gloom - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🧡 WISHLIST NOW ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453420?utm_source=trailer

Shroud of Gloom is a point-and-click horror adventure. Investigate an old manor, gather items and clues to solve environmental puzzles and discover dark secrets. Can you uncover the mystery… and make it out alive?

Hired as a Private Investigator, you arrive at Crawford Manor to investigate the disappearance of Edmund Sullivan. What begins as a routine case quickly spirals into something far more sinister.

🎬 Watch the first behind-the-scenes devlog ► https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sk3V1hXuNog
🔴 Follow the development on Twitch ► https://www.twitch.tv/madchirpy
👾 Join the Discord ► https://discord.com/invite/cFFBq6g

Music by Lind
Narration by Patrick Lamb

#indiegame #pointandclick #trailer
